meta.name: Love Is Fate
meta.description:
After surviving a near-fatal accident, hotel heiress Ma Keai returns home to inherit her father’s hotel empire, only to become entangled in a series of dangerous incidents. With Xia Yuxing by her side, she uncovers a hidden conspiracy threatening both her life and her family’s legacy.

Complete series. On your server: S1 48/48

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ma Ke'ai faces a scandal involving Liu Bin’s misconduct, while Lu Zhenzhen arrives with a secret. Ma forces Liu to apologize, saving JR Hotel's reputation.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Rumors of haunting lead to a sleepwalking case; Ma resolves the issue. Lu blackmails Ma, while Xia and Ma bond under the stars.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Han Yuanbin returns from the dead, but Ma chooses her career. Xia and Yang foil an insurance scam involving artist Yu Qiubai.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Xia and Ma expose a scheme against Yu Qiubai. A fake wedding between Bai Yan and Ziqi leads to emotional turmoil.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Bai’s secret daughter is revealed, and Ziqi confesses her love. Yiyi’s hospitalization brings emotional clarity.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Bai isn't Yiyi's real father but vows to protect her. Ziqi stays by his side, while Song Tianming's involvement raises red flags.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Zhao and Song target Ma; Han joins JR and stirs jealousy. Xia bonds with Ziqi and finds proof of Bai's love.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Xia impersonates a critic to protect JR. Bai earns Ziqi's parents' respect, but keeps his distance.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Yiyi collapses, and Ma and Ziqi rally to help. Bai shares his reasons for leaving, while Song digs into Ma's past.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Bai and Ziqi reunite. Ma saves JR’s finances, and Xia confesses his love as new mysteries surface.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Rumors harm Ma and Xia; Sun Qian comforts a grieving couple by posing as their granddaughter. Han returns, stirring tension.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Ma helps a mother and autistic son, recalling her own childhood. Xia supports her as internal corruption grows.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Xia aids a man with dementia; Ma's health worsens. Suspicions of child abuse prompt an investigation.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Tax evasion and food scandals rock JR. Han pushes Ma to leave for treatment, but she resists.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Ma's trauma resurfaces; Xia comforts her. The child abuse case is resolved, and Ma's brain injury is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Ma rejects treatment again. Xia uncovers kitchen theft, and Lu Zhenzhen fuels drama.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Ma's health declines further; a business deal collapses under suspicious circumstances. Xia and Ma grow closer.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Fraud scandal erupts; Ma collapses again. Xia finds her medical records, uncovering the truth.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Xia urges Ma to get help, but she refuses. Staff morale rises, and Han plans to take Ma away.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Ma chooses Xia and agrees to surgery. JR is saved, and the series ends with a hopeful embrace.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Ma, Xia, and Han are introduced amid embezzlement suspicions. A fake ledger hints at deeper conspiracies.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Ma and Xia grow close while Lu and Zhou’s public feud erupts. Han begins plotting against Xia.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Han kidnaps Ma; Xia rescues them and gains trust. Evidence links Zhao to the incident.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Hu Jia survives a suspicious accident; Ma suspends Xia over food poisoning framed by Han and Zhao.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Xia is accused, but Lu and Yang uncover the real saboteurs. Ma faces a dilemma over loyalty and truth.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Ma clears Xia’s name; Han and Zhao’s alliance falls apart. Lu’s assistant is caught leaking fake news.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Han invites a troublesome client to sabotage Xia. A brawl erupts, leading to Xia’s suspension.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Ma defends Xia and finds the plot's source in Thailand. Guo Yu flees as Han refuses to confess.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Xia proves Han’s guilt. Ma fires Han, and Guo is arrested. Ma and Xia reconcile emotionally.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: JR stabilizes; Xia is promoted, and Ma visits her ailing father. The hotel’s future looks brighter.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Ma faces a shareholder revolt but survives. Xia returns in secret to support her.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Ma boosts JR’s reputation through global deals. Han reappears, complicating her bond with Xia.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Han's scandal surfaces. Xia uncovers corruption, and feelings stir between him and Ma.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Han apologizes; Xia’s scar reminds Ma of a childhood savior. Song suspects Xia is his son.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Shareholders pressure Ma to marry Han. Xia wrestles with identity, and Ma chooses duty over love.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Han publicly announces the engagement. Xia joins Song’s team to dig for dirt.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Song secretly collects DNA to test Xia. Childhood memories resurface, and Song hides the truth.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Xia learns Song is his father. Han decides to help Ma, while a secret trust fund is discovered.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Xia cooks for Song, sparking paternal feelings. Song plots sabotage while Yang dodges DNA testing.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Song confirms Xia is his son but keeps silent. Xia exposes Song's schemes, and Ma reclaims JR.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Song names Yang Li as his son. Ma finds a ring linking Xia and Yang’s past with her father’s feud.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Xia and Yang expose Zhao. Ma searches for answers, while Song doubts Yang’s paternity.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Xia is revealed as Song’s real son. Ma’s father wakes and reveals Song’s dark past.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Xia is kidnapped; Song rescues him. Peace is restored as Song confesses and turns himself in.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Song sacrifices himself for Xia's future. Ma loses her memory, and Xia builds a cabin to restore it.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Ma sees Xia's viral message and escapes Han. They reunite, but she collapses from a brain hemorrhage.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Xia brings Ma to their cabin; her memories stir. Han consents to surgery as Ma's life hangs in balance.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Ma survives but forgets Xia. They reunite at the cabin, and a new love story begins.
